title: Warm German Pork Casserole
description: A hearty and flavorful German-inspired casserole featuring pork, ginger cordial, and bonito flakes, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This dish is kid-friendly and incorporates anti-inflammatory ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the pork sausage into 1-inch pieces and cook in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the grated ginger and cook for an additional minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked pork and onion mixture, bonito flakes, chicken broth, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Slice the carrots and potatoes into 1-inch pieces and add to the bowl, stirring to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and stir in the ginger cordial.
Return the dish to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the casserole is hot and the vegetables are tender.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
